description:
Activate Juju Bubble by paying {2}, causing you to gain 2 life due to Cleric Class.
Cleric Class's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
